## What changed

Describe the resource or correction and why it improves the collection.

## Evidence

Link the primary source and any evidence used for the description or inclusion decision.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request covers one resource or one tightly related correction.
- [ ] I searched the repository for duplicates.
- [ ] Every new URL is specific, public, and currently works.
- [ ] Descriptions are factual and avoid promotional claims.
- [ ] New entries follow the target section's ordering and format.
- [ ] I disclosed any affiliation with the resource.
- [ ] `node .github/scripts/validate-curation.mjs` passes locally.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full quality bar.
